title: Silver Bridge collapse: drowning victims hear numbers
place_text: Silver Bridge, Point Pleasant (said as Pennsylvania)

tellings.quote: a sudden they heard number 3004 number 3,486 number 3,486 wake up wake up and they like came back to life

plain: When the Silver Bridge at Point Pleasant collapsed in 1967, some people drowning in the river are said to have suddenly heard voices calling out numbers, "number 3004, number 3,486", and "wake up, wake up", and then came back to life. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells this on the show, placing the bridge in Pennsylvania and citing John Keel, an author who wrote about strange events there. He tells it as a sign that some unseen intelligence intervened.
